decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The operating hours hereby approved shall be for a limited period of 12 months from the first day of written notice from the Council that a premises license for the operation of the use has been obtained and/or within three years of the date of this decision. From the first day trading following the end of the limited period of 12 months, subject to obtaining a premises licence as above, the opening hours shall revert back to 6am - 2am (Sunday to Wednesday) and 6am - 3am (Thursday to Saturday and Bank Holidays) unless planning permission through a further application has been obtained from the Council.
Reason: To allow the local planning authority to review the impact of the extended hours on the amenities of the neighbourhood, in accordance with Council policies LP1 and LP2 of the Wandsworth Local Plan (2023) coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework 2026.

Condition : 2 - INFORMATIVE: In dealing with this application the Council has implemented the requirement in the National Planning Policy Framework to work with the applicant in a positive and proactive manner and the Council has, as far as practicable, sought solutions to problems arising in relation to dealing with the planning application. The Council has made available detailed advice in the form of its statutory policies in the Local Plan (2023) as well as offering a full pre-application advice service, in order to ensure that the applicant has been given every opportunity to submit an application which is likely to be considered favourably. In addition, where appropriate, further guidance was offered to the applicant during the processing of the application.
description: Variation of condition (d) opening hours of planning permission dated 07/02/1980  ref 79/N/2490 (Use of shop and basement as restaurant, store and ancillary staff facilities.) to allow 24 hour operation of the restaurant.
